CustomField.description: Optional. The module's links for the BarnCRM Home tab's Quick Links, separated by semicolons, each Target:Label:Line. Line is the key of the tile's one-line description in Core's BarnHelp catalog. Target is a tab API name unprefixed, or an object unprefixed with .new for its new record form. Shown while the module is installed and turned on (D-200 R7).
CustomField.label: Quick Links
